text: ghostty --class=NAME sets the Wayland app id, but GTK takes only a valid application id (reverse-DNS, each element starting with a letter); a bare word falls back to com.mitchellh.ghostty. decade places terminals by app id decade.w<id>.<pane>, or decade.w<id>.<pane>.t<n> for pane tabs (Children::ghostty in src/server/children.rs). Layout::place also matches a renamed pane's former names (Pane::answers_to in src/server/panes.rs). Seen 2026-11-06.
